source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「機体の動力源」(2)3)複数セルLiPoの取扱上の注意

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 複数セルLiPoではセルバランスを保つためbalance connectorを充電器へ接続する。
evidence.tested_misconception: balance connectorは不要または飛行時だけ使う。
evidence.reasoning_path: multi-cell battery -> cell imbalance risk -> balance charging connection

collision.note: LOW。既存battery問題にcell balancingは未出。

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 requires balance charging and connection of the balance connector for multi-cell LiPo packs; no canonical cell-balance item exists.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
